tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Battlefield background behind the placement grid. Darkest ground; neon reads best here.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: App background for menus, shop and meta screens.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Panels, bottom sheet, HUD bar backing (at 88% opacity over the battlefield).

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Raised elements on panels: cards, list rows, secondary button fill.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Battlefield placement grid lines, 1px. Decorative only, never meaning.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on panels.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary button, inputs, tabs). Holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, stat names on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholder text only. Never carries information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: PERIMETER's signal colour (acid lime): primary buttons, selection, valid placement, focus ring.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent, reward or warning fill.

tokens.name: dmg-energy
tokens.usage: Energy damage: beams, towers, damage numbers. Shape: DIAMOND + bolt. Projectile: continuous beam.

tokens.name: dmg-kinetic
tokens.usage: Kinetic damage: slugs, shells, damage numbers. Shape: SQUARE + slug. Projectile: short solid dash.

tokens.name: dmg-cryo
tokens.usage: Utility/Cryo damage and slow effects. Shape: HEXAGON + snowflake. Projectile: ring burst.

tokens.name: hp
tokens.usage: Enemy hull (HP) bar fill: solid, neutral, 4px.

tokens.name: def-shield
tokens.usage: Enemy Shield layer (regenerates). Segmented bar above HP + circular bubble ring around the enemy.

tokens.name: def-armor
tokens.usage: Enemy Armor layer. Hatched bar between shield and HP + corner brackets on the enemy.

tokens.name: cur-credits
tokens.usage: Credits (per-run). Icon: COIN (circle + slot).

tokens.name: cur-cores
tokens.usage: Cores (permanent). Icon: CUBE (isometric hexagon with Y).

tokens.name: cur-shards
tokens.usage: Shards (permanent, rare). Icon: CRYSTAL (tall faceted diamond).

tokens.name: rar-common
tokens.usage: Common artifact: 1 pip, square frame, no glow.

tokens.name: rar-rare
tokens.usage: Rare artifact: 2 pips, one chamfered corner, small glow.

tokens.name: rar-epic
tokens.usage: Epic artifact: 3 pips, two chamfered corners, medium glow.

tokens.name: rar-legendary
tokens.usage: Legendary artifact: 4 pips, four chamfered corners + double frame, large glow.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid placement, purchase done, wave cleared. Always with the CHECK icon or a solid outline.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Invalid placement, base damage, errors. Always with the X/octagon icon or diagonal hatching.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Boss alert and caution. Always with the TRIANGLE icon and hazard stripes.

tokens.name: reward
tokens.usage: Rewarded-ad button and ad-granted bonuses. Always with the PLAY-in-circle icon.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Screen titles and wave banners (WAVE 30, BASE BREACHED). Uppercase.

styles.name: hud-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number on the HUD: base integrity or wave counter. Tabular figures.

styles.name: hud-lg
styles.usage: Currency counters in the HUD bar. Tabular figures.

styles.name: hud-md
styles.usage: Tower stats, timers, small HUD numbers. Tabular figures.

styles.name: dmg-number
styles.usage: Floating damage numbers, coloured by damage type (bake as BitmapText).

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Card titles, tower names, artifact names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Descriptions and panel copy. 16px is the floor for reading text in sunlight.
styles.sample: Chains to 3 nearby enemies. +40% vs Shield.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines under stats and buttons. Never smaller.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase stat labels and tags. The smallest size in the game.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Primary and rewarded-ad button labels. Uppercase.

styles.name: button-md
styles.usage: Secondary and compact button labels. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-number gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips, pips, bar layers.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button inner padding (vertical), list-row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above the bottom action bar; thumb-zone clearance.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Grid tiles, bars, the battlefield.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pips, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Circular icons, shield bubble, coin.

chamfer.note: PERIMETER cuts corners instead of rounding them. A chamfer is a 45-degree cut of this size.

tokens.name: chamfer-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small cards, tags.

tokens.name: chamfer-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, artifact cards, panels.

tokens.name: chamfer-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, bottom sheet top corners, boss banner.

stroke.note: Stroke widths in logical px at 1x (multiply by devicePixelRatio when baking). Anything that carries meaning is at least stroke-2.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Battlefield grid and panel dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: Icons drawn at 16px or smaller.

tokens.name: stroke-2
tokens.usage: Default: icons, enemy outlines, projectiles, control borders.

tokens.name: stroke-3
tokens.usage: Towers, selected items, elite enemies.

tokens.name: stroke-4
tokens.usage: Bosses, the base perimeter ring, boss-alert frame.

glow.note: Outer glow = halo radius drawn as two extra additive passes of the same path (see README: Glow). Pick by importance, not by size.

tokens.name: glow-0
tokens.usage: No glow: disabled, secondary buttons, text, panels.

tokens.name: glow-sm
tokens.usage: Projectiles, enemy outlines, currency icons, rare frames.

tokens.name: glow-md
tokens.usage: Towers, primary button, epic frames, damage-type icons.

tokens.name: glow-lg
tokens.usage: Bosses, base hit flash, legendary frames, boss alert.

glowAlpha.note: Alpha of each additive pass. Values sum to under 1 so overlapping glows bloom without clipping to white too early.

tokens.name: glow-core
tokens.usage: Pass 1: the stroke itself, full colour, width = stroke.

tokens.name: glow-hot
tokens.usage: Pass 2: white hot core, width = stroke x 0.5. Only glow-md and up.

tokens.name: glow-near
tokens.usage: Pass 3: halo, width = stroke + halo, same colour.

tokens.name: glow-far
tokens.usage: Pass 4: halo, width = stroke + 2 x halo, same colour.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for anything tappable.

tokens.name: button-h-lg
tokens.usage: Primary and rewarded-ad button height.

tokens.name: button-h-md
tokens.usage: Secondary and disabled button height.

tokens.name: thumb-zone
tokens.usage: Bottom share of the screen that holds every frequent control (one-handed play).
